dataset: Lee et al. OpenBMI (2019), session 1, labeled offline blocks only
protocol_note: Specified before inspecting waveforms or classifier outcomes. One-second frames, each charged complete ZIP bytes and reconstruction metadata. Encoder selects minimum sample MSE among the declared candidates satisfying each per-frame byte cap, without labels or classifier scores. Original-data per-subject classifiers fitted on early offline events; late events evaluated with two-second boundary guard. No classifier retraining after compression. Every eligible subject and task reported, including weak baselines. Development subjects excluded from final averages. No universal task ranking or clinical claim.
